items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Working toward return, but timetable TBD
items.text:
Coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that Henderson (illness) is working hard to get back, while acknowledging that he doesn't have a timetable for when that may occur, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Practices again Friday
items.text:

items.title: Rachaad White: Leads backfield in win
items.text:
White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy: Impressive numbers in loss
items.text:
McCarthy completed 23 of 36 passes for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding six rushes for 34 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Records game-winning TD in victory
items.text:
Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.
